elements.label: Royal Small Arms Factory
elements.description: Built in the early last century, the Small Arms Factory has faithfully produced firearms and ammunition for the British cause throughout a hundred years. Even today, as the city suffers bombings and the ground nears collapse, the factory’s furnaces have not ceased burning. If only the newly established branch factories could be as diligent as this one itself.

elements.label: 'Cradle of Gods'
elements.description: According to Hokobald himself, this place was to be where 'the gods of gold and bronze' would be crafted—which would have been his greatest, though not final, masterpiece. I suppose his grand design will never come to pass, yet some of the equipment here may still be of use to me.

elements.label: Beneath the Church of Saint Kentigern
elements.description: This hidden shrine is older than many gods worshipped today. In that well-known age long past, its allegiance belonged briefly to the magnificent Sun; after its fall, the persecuted faithful sought shelter under the Mother of Ants. Now it offers devotion once more to the Sun—but the Sun is no longer what it was, and there is more than one of it. Mortal constructions sometimes endure surprisingly long.

elements.label: Rosslyn Chapel
elements.description: Since the Intercalate, this humble chapel on the outskirts of the city has remained dedicated to sheltering worshippers of the Sun who arrive. Members changed, stones and tiles were replaced—and even the object of faith eventually shifted. Yet the clerics have steadfastly upheld this duty, down to the present day

elements.label: Ogófen Finland Dù Cave
elements.description: Faintly shimmering tracks traverse hills and valleys, delve into rock crevices, and finally vanish downward into darkness. Whatever treasure the Centipede has left deeper within, the path to it is clearly no easy one. Best to be thoroughly prepared.

elements.label: A Sanctuary Under the Waterfall
elements.description: The True Sisterhood—these dissidents who split from the Sisterhood of the Knot were hunted down by more dominant faiths in all histories. After losing most of their members, the location of their stronghold in northern England became a complete mystery—at least to mortals and Longs alike.

elements.label: Paddock Bunker
elements.description: Before the war situation deteriorated, I personally oversaw the construction of this facility to safeguard a critical part of my grand plan—perhaps it was even fortified too well, as not even the Germans' repeated bombings managed to shake it in the slightest. Now, trying to discreetly open its gates has become a task that torments even myself.

elements.label: The Black Bazaar
elements.description: Feverish rumors sweep through the alleyways: a so-called 'Book of Prophets' from across the distant continent is to be auctioned here at an exorbitant price. Its prophecies never fail—though only fragments of the text remain legible to those who glimpse it. If the rumors hold truth, then it rightfully should be mine; if not... I intended to cleanse this place anyway.

elements.label: The Traitor's Grave
elements.description: Forge-of-Days, deceived, devoured the leader of the Red Rose herself. Yet after that disaster, the fate of the remaining kin faded into the shadows of history. Now the aged trail of the Centipede has led me here—foreseeing this moment, or merely to show me something? Perhaps I will never know. Or perhaps knowing never mattered.

elements.label: The Collapsed Dock
elements.description: The German bombing struck with sudden and unforeseen ferocity: before anyone could react, a blast of staggering magnitude had utterly demolished my ally’s berthing area, and their own equipment proved inadequate for the cleanup—as the supervisor explained to me. Yet, in this world, nothing truly occurs without warning; there are only oversights and fleeting strokes of luck.

elements.label: Lethe's Hideout
elements.description: In the recent airstrike, one of the caches I had prepared for the great cause suffered damage beyond expectation, giving this rabble—urged on by the Obliviates—a chance to plunder amidst the chaos. It is time to reclaim what is mine and make them pay the price for their actions.

elements.label: Ruined Sanctuary
elements.description: This scarcely concealed refuge bears clear signs of violence and chilled orichalc blood. Hokobald’s fate seems grim, yet I can still search the place carefully and salvage any remaining resources worth using.

elements.label: Breeze Collection
elements.description: Despite being miles away from the coastline, the third holder of the pearl drowned with his lungs filled with saltwater. This thoroughly terrified the locals, leading them to believe the pearl—or even the building itself—was cursed. Even left unattended, no thief dared to steal from it. Superstition sometimes has its advantages.
